name: Banco de Chile
verdict: Controlled by Quiñenco (LQIF holds 51.2% of voting and economic rights). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: front-of-shirt main sponsor of Chile's national rugby team ('main sponsor' since December 2022, renewed June 2024 per rugbychile.cl). Ownership per Quiñenco's own page (claim quinenco-banco-de-chile-ownership): LQIF, held 50/50 by Quiñenco (Luksic group) and Citigroup. No state stake and no qualifying human-rights record identified for the bank or its owners.
